note: archon enroll's formats (docs/enroll.md §2–§3, ADR 0013): the intent in format 1, the challenge token, the request a challenge token yields, and the proof token. Text fields are hex in the cases so non-UTF-8 text can be a case; token texts are given exactly, as JSON strings. The display-unsafe set is vectors/display-unsafe.json's. Every byte is assembled by hand from the specification (vectors/tools/enroll-vectors.py), outside the three lanes.

enroll_intent_encode.name: basic
enroll_intent_encode.note: the intent in format 1: 0x01 ‖ u16 blind ‖ u16 account ref ‖ u16 account name ‖ u16 purpose ‖ u8 count ‖ (u16 restriction)*. Inputs {intent} with every text field as hex; expected {ok: hex} or {error: true}.

enroll_intent_encode.name: restrictions
enroll_intent_encode.note: two restrictions, kept in order.

enroll_intent_encode.name: restrictions-32
enroll_intent_encode.note: 32 restrictions is the most.

enroll_intent_encode.name: restrictions-33
enroll_intent_encode.note: 33 restrictions are refused.

enroll_intent_encode.name: blind-64
enroll_intent_encode.note: a 64-byte blind is the longest.

enroll_intent_encode.name: blind-15
enroll_intent_encode.note: a 15-byte blind is refused: the blind must carry at least 128 bits.

enroll_intent_encode.name: blind-65
enroll_intent_encode.note: a 65-byte blind is refused.

enroll_intent_encode.name: ref-empty
enroll_intent_encode.note: an empty account id is refused.

enroll_intent_encode.name: ref-255
enroll_intent_encode.note: a 255-byte account id is the longest.

enroll_intent_encode.name: ref-256
enroll_intent_encode.note: a 256-byte account id is refused.

enroll_intent_encode.name: name-non-ascii
enroll_intent_encode.note: non-ASCII text that is display-safe is allowed.

enroll_intent_encode.name: name-lookalike
enroll_intent_encode.note: a Cyrillic а (U+0430) is display-safe: look-alikes are not in the set, and the command cannot catch them (docs/enroll.md §6).

enroll_intent_encode.name: name-zero-width
enroll_intent_encode.note: a zero-width space (U+200B, Cf) is refused.

enroll_intent_encode.name: name-bidi
enroll_intent_encode.note: a right-to-left override (U+202E) is refused.

enroll_intent_encode.name: name-bom
enroll_intent_encode.note: a byte-order mark (U+FEFF, Cf) at the start of a name is refused, not dropped: a decoder that strips a leading BOM would show a name other than the bytes.

enroll_intent_encode.name: name-c1
enroll_intent_encode.note: a C1 control (U+0085) is refused.

enroll_intent_encode.name: name-not-utf8
enroll_intent_encode.note: text that is not UTF-8 is refused.

enroll_intent_encode.name: name-encoded-surrogate
enroll_intent_encode.note: a UTF-8-encoded surrogate (ED A0 80) is not well-formed UTF-8 and is refused.

enroll_intent_encode.name: purpose-empty
enroll_intent_encode.note: an empty purpose is refused.

enroll_intent_encode.name: purpose-control
enroll_intent_encode.note: a control character in the purpose is refused.

enroll_intent_encode.name: purpose-rotate
enroll_intent_encode.note: any display-safe purpose encodes; which purposes a command renders is the command's rule.

enroll_intent_encode.name: restriction-empty
enroll_intent_encode.note: an empty restriction is refused.

enroll_intent_encode.name: restriction-separator
enroll_intent_encode.note: a line separator (U+2028, Zl) in a restriction is refused.

enroll_intent_encode.name: restriction-soft-hyphen
enroll_intent_encode.note: a soft hyphen (U+00AD, default ignorable) in a restriction is refused.

enroll_intent_decode.name: basic
enroll_intent_decode.note: decoding format 1: inputs {bytes}; expected {ok: {blind, account_id, account_name, purpose, restrictions}} with text as hex, or {error: true}.

enroll_intent_decode.name: format-2
enroll_intent_decode.note: an unknown format byte is refused, never skipped.

enroll_intent_decode.name: trailing
enroll_intent_decode.note: a byte after the last restriction is refused.

enroll_intent_decode.name: length-past-end
enroll_intent_decode.note: a field length that runs past the end.

enroll_intent_decode.name: blind-15
enroll_intent_decode.note: a 15-byte blind is refused at decoding too.

enroll_intent_decode.name: blind-64
enroll_intent_decode.note: a 64-byte blind is the longest a decoder reads.

enroll_intent_decode.name: blind-65
enroll_intent_decode.note: a 65-byte blind is refused at decoding too: the bound is checked on both sides, not only by the encoder.

enroll_intent_decode.name: count-33
enroll_intent_decode.note: a count of 33 is refused, whatever follows.

enroll_intent_decode.name: count-over-content
enroll_intent_decode.note: a count of 2 with one restriction present.

enroll_intent_decode.name: name-bidi
enroll_intent_decode.note: an encoder would refuse it; a decoder refuses it too.

enroll_intent_decode.name: name-bom
enroll_intent_decode.note: a name whose bytes begin EF BB BF is refused: a UTF-8 decoder that silently strips a leading BOM would accept it and show the name without it.

enroll_intent_decode.name: ref-bom
enroll_intent_decode.note: the first text field after the blind, beginning with a BOM, is refused too.

enroll_intent_decode.name: not-utf8
enroll_intent_decode.note: a restriction that is not UTF-8.

enroll_challenge_encode.name: basic
enroll_challenge_encode.note: the challenge token: archon-enroll-challenge-1: then lowercase hex of u16 audience ‖ u16 transaction ‖ u16 nonce ‖ new key[32] ‖ u16 intent ‖ u64 deadline. Inputs {challenge}; expected {ok: text} or {error: true}.

enroll_challenge_encode.name: intent-opaque
enroll_challenge_encode.note: the token's codec checks its own fields only: an intent that is not format 1 still encodes, and is refused when the command decodes it.

enroll_challenge_encode.name: transaction-255
enroll_challenge_encode.note: a 255-byte transaction id is the longest.

enroll_challenge_encode.name: transaction-empty
enroll_challenge_encode.note: an empty transaction id is refused.

enroll_challenge_encode.name: audience-control
enroll_challenge_encode.note: a control character in the audience is refused.

enroll_challenge_encode.name: audience-c1
enroll_challenge_encode.note: a C1 control (U+009B, the 8-bit CSI) in the audience is refused: the binding's rule admits it, and a refusal would print it.

enroll_challenge_encode.name: audience-bidi
enroll_challenge_encode.note: a right-to-left override in the audience is refused.

enroll_challenge_encode.name: deadline-zero
enroll_challenge_encode.note: deadline 0 encodes; whether it has passed is the command's check.

enroll_challenge_encode.name: size-over
enroll_challenge_encode.note: a token over 65536 bytes is refused at writing too.

enroll_challenge_decode.name: basic
enroll_challenge_decode.note: reading a challenge token: inputs {text}; expected {ok: {audience, transaction, nonce, new_key, intent, deadline}} or {error: true}.

enroll_challenge_decode.name: whitespace
enroll_challenge_decode.note: leading and trailing tabs, line feeds, carriage returns and spaces are ignored.

enroll_challenge_decode.name: whitespace-inside
enroll_challenge_decode.note: whitespace inside the token is refused.

enroll_challenge_decode.name: whitespace-nbsp
enroll_challenge_decode.note: a no-break space (U+00A0) around the token is not whitespace here, and is refused.

enroll_challenge_decode.name: whitespace-formfeed
enroll_challenge_decode.note: a form feed around the token is refused.

enroll_challenge_decode.name: uppercase
enroll_challenge_decode.note: uppercase hex is refused.

enroll_challenge_decode.name: no-prefix
enroll_challenge_decode.note: the hex alone is refused.

enroll_challenge_decode.name: proof-prefix
enroll_challenge_decode.note: a proof token's prefix is refused.

enroll_challenge_decode.name: prefix-version-2
enroll_challenge_decode.note: another version's prefix is refused.

enroll_challenge_decode.name: odd-hex
enroll_challenge_decode.note: an odd number of hex digits is refused.

enroll_challenge_decode.name: trailing-byte
enroll_challenge_decode.note: a byte after the deadline is refused.

enroll_challenge_decode.name: truncated
enroll_challenge_decode.note: the deadline cut short.

enroll_challenge_decode.name: at-bound
enroll_challenge_decode.note: a token of exactly 65536 bytes is read.

enroll_challenge_decode.name: over-bound
enroll_challenge_decode.note: 65538 bytes are refused.

enroll_challenge_decode.name: deadline-max
enroll_challenge_decode.note: 9999-12-31T23:59:59Z, the latest deadline, is read: its high 32 bits are the most a reader that splits the u64 accepts.

enroll_challenge_decode.name: deadline-high-word-over
enroll_challenge_decode.note: a deadline whose high 32 bits exceed the latest deadline's is refused, whatever its low bits.

enroll_challenge_decode.name: deadline-over
enroll_challenge_decode.note: a deadline after 9999-12-31T23:59:59Z is refused.

enroll_challenge_decode.name: nonce-15
enroll_challenge_decode.note: a 15-byte nonce is refused.

enroll_challenge_decode.name: new-key-short
enroll_challenge_decode.note: a key field that eats the intent's length leaves the token malformed.

enroll_challenge_decode.name: audience-not-utf8
enroll_challenge_decode.note: an audience that is not UTF-8 is refused.

enroll_challenge_decode.name: audience-control
enroll_challenge_decode.note: a control character in the audience is refused.

enroll_challenge_decode.name: audience-c1
enroll_challenge_decode.note: a C1 control (U+009B) in the audience is refused at decoding, before any refusal could print it.

enroll_challenge_decode.name: audience-bidi
enroll_challenge_decode.note: a right-to-left override in the audience is refused at decoding.

enroll_challenge_decode.name: intent-empty
enroll_challenge_decode.note: an empty intent is refused.

enroll_challenge_decode.name: intent-opaque
enroll_challenge_decode.note: an intent that is not format 1 is read: the token checks its own fields.

enroll_challenge_request.name: basic
enroll_challenge_request.note: the request a challenge token yields: the token's nonce, transaction and new key, the INTENT's purpose, and SHA-256 of the token's intent bytes (docs/enroll.md §3). Inputs {text}; expected {ok: {audience, request}} with request spelled as vectors/request.json spells one (purpose as hex), or {error: true}.

enroll_challenge_request.name: restrictions
enroll_challenge_request.note: restrictions change the intent's bytes, so they change the digest.

enroll_challenge_request.name: other-blind
enroll_challenge_request.note: the same account under another blind is another digest.

enroll_challenge_request.name: purpose-rotate
enroll_challenge_request.note: the purpose comes from the intent; the sdk derives any purpose, and the command decides which it renders.

enroll_challenge_request.name: intent-not-format-1
enroll_challenge_request.note: an intent that is not format 1 yields no request.

enroll_challenge_request.name: intent-unsafe
enroll_challenge_request.note: an intent with a display-unsafe name yields no request.

enroll_challenge_request.name: token-malformed
enroll_challenge_request.note: a malformed token yields no request.

enroll_proof_encode.name: basic
enroll_proof_encode.note: the proof token: archon-enroll-proof-1: then lowercase hex of u16 transaction ‖ new key[32] ‖ proof[64]. Inputs {proof_token}; expected {ok: text} or {error: true}.

enroll_proof_encode.name: transaction-255
enroll_proof_encode.note: a 255-byte transaction id is the longest.

enroll_proof_encode.name: transaction-empty
enroll_proof_encode.note: an empty transaction id is refused.

enroll_proof_decode.name: basic
enroll_proof_decode.note: reading a proof token: inputs {text}; expected {ok: {transaction, new_key, proof}} or {error: true}.

enroll_proof_decode.name: challenge-prefix
enroll_proof_decode.note: a challenge token's prefix is refused.

enroll_proof_decode.name: trailing-byte
enroll_proof_decode.note: a byte after the proof is refused.

enroll_proof_decode.name: transaction-zero
enroll_proof_decode.note: a transaction length of 0 is refused.
